cohort: The study included 850 pregnant women, 100 of whom presented with meconium-stained amniotic fluid, to evaluate its impact on neonatal outcomes.
finding: The incidence of MSAF was 11.76%, and neonates born with MSAF experienced significantly lower Apgar scores, higher NICU admission rates, increased neonatal sepsis, and higher mortality rates compared to the non-MSAF group.
